name: La Puebla de Arganzón (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a white cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Puebla de Arganzón (a castle on red supported by two lions above waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 22 September 1997 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 241 of 8 October 1997); the arms are blazoned gules, a castle or supported by two lions argent on waves of argent and azure.

features.role: La Puebla de Arganzón arms — castle supported by lions above waves
